name: input
title: Input
description: Native text input with invalid-state styling.

.caps-input,.caps-input:disabled.boxShadow:
inset 0 0 0 var(--caps-input-edge-width) var(--caps-input-edge),
      inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.07)),
      inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(100% 0 0 / calc(var(--depth) * 0.02))
.caps-input,.caps-input:disabled.transition:
border-color var(--stipe-motion-fast) ease,
      box-shadow var(--stipe-motion-fast) ease
